combines_page.meta_description: The Small combo, the Big combo, the Gold selection and the scorer of the day, published before kick-off. Wins and losses shown.
combines_page.title: Today's combos
combines_page.sub: Published before kick-off, wins and losses shown. Each ticket combines single bets picked by the same rule every day.
combines_page.empty: Today's combos arrive every morning, as soon as the daily calculation is done.
combines_page.rule_small: 3 to 5 matches, total odds between 4.00 and 6.00. Open with a free account.
combines_page.rule_big: 5 to 7 matches, total odds between 8.50 and 12.00. With Pro.
combines_page.rule_gold: The 3 most likely bets of the day. With Pro.
combines_page.rule_scorer: The player most likely to score, among the expected starters. With Pro.
combines_page.rules_note: Every bet in a ticket has odds between 1.40 and 2.20 and at least a 50% calculated chance. An estimate, never a guarantee.
